Greek Ribs
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:20pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup Butter
1 teaspoon Garlic powder, or more to taste
3 pounds Pork spareribs

Preparation

1 Lemon juice oregano 2 Combine butter and garlic. Rub garlic mixture on both sides of ribs. 3 Squeeze fresh lemon juice all over ribs. Sprinkle oregano all over ribs. 4 Place in oven. Bake at 350 F for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Baste lemon juice over meat several times during baking and just before serving. 5 Makesexcellent finger food! Serves 4.
